args.message: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was incorrectly using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This PR corrects `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so:
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` (rounds up, since 8 is even)
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (rounds down, since 6 is even)

The docstring already stated the FIN-212 requirement; only the implementation was wrong.

## Testing

CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.

@alex please review — happy to make any adjustments needed.
